tagline: A decade of quantum on the cloud
heroDescription: A global celebration of quantum computing and the incredible community building the future. Join workshops, talks, hackathons and more!

about.heading: What is Qiskit Fall Fest?
about.description: Qiskit Fall Fest is an annual celebration of quantum computing and the community building it forward. Expect inspiring talks, hands-on workshops, hackathons, and plenty of opportunities to learn, build and connect.
